messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired for service 'redis-cluster-prod' — alert: redis:maxclients_exceeded on redis-node-3. Severity=P1. Incident: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345|PD12345>

pagerduty: Auto-assigned to @sam (eng-oncall). Escalation policy: immediate.

sam: acked — I'm on it. Seeing high 5xx from API and app logs show: "ERR max number of clients reached" across multiple redis nodes.

sam: quick triage:
```
# check clients on node-3
redis-cli -h redis-node-3 INFO clients
# sample output
connected_clients: 10240
blocked_clients: 12
maxclients: 10000
```

matt: also getting pg connection growth in api-prod. pgbouncer shows total_client_connections spiking. Might be cascade: Redis timeouts causing app threads to hold DB transactions longer.

jade: passing to me for mitigation. Initial plan: 1) throttle edge traffic for heavy endpoints, 2) add temporary redis capacity / increase maxclients, 3) enable graceful degrade for non-critical features.

opsbot: scaling action queued: starting additional redis pods (scale statefulset redis-cluster -> +2). Nodes provisioning (pods pending). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: applying quick rate-limit to /v1/generate to 10rps per IP to reduce connection churn.
```
# temporary gateway rule
redwood-router-cli set-rate-limit --route /v1/generate --limit 10rps --scope ip --note "incident PD12345 throttle"
```

support-lead: posting customer notice on status page: "We are investigating increased errors affecting text-generation endpoints; mitigations in progress." <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/redis-2026-03-15|status link> :loudspeaker:

oncall-runbook-bot: runbook excerpt for redis:maxclients_exceeded:
- verify connected_clients vs maxclients
- if clients >> maxclients and autoscale available, add capacity first
- avoid CONFIG SET maxclients in prod without testing; prefer adding nodes or draining.
- if immediate relief required, CONFIG SET + CONFIG REWRITE then monitor.

jade: given traffic and quick need, I'll add capacity and concurrently CONFIG SET maxclients to 8000 on node-3 as short-term relief (we'll roll and monitor).
```
redis-cli -h redis-node-3 CONFIG SET maxclients 8000
redis-cli -h redis-node-3 CONFIG REWRITE
```

sam: checking client list patterns to find long-lived connections / leaks:
```
redis-cli -h redis-node-3 CLIENT LIST | awk -F ' ' '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /cmd=/) print $0}' | head -n 8
# sample lines show many 'ping' and 'get' commands, also a chunk of clients idle>60000ms
```

matt: confirming pgbouncer stats — spike correlates with redis latency windows:
```
# pgbouncer SHOW STATS
total_request: 987654
avg_query_time: 120ms -> spiking to 2s during redis timeouts
```

jade: opsbot reports two new redis pods became Ready; cluster rebalanced. Initial client pressure dropped ~30%.

opsbot: autoscale completed, new pods redis-node-6 and -7 Ready.

sam: after throttle + scale + config adjust, error rate for generation endpoints dropped from ~14% 5xx to ~1.2% within 6 minutes. Latency improved but still elevated.

support-lead: customers notified update #1: mitigation reduced errors; further monitoring ongoing.

pagerduty: Note: escalation timer set — will auto-escalate to SRE lead @maria if incident not resolved in 15 minutes.

jade: follow-ups: 1) investigate client churn source (likely retry storm from an upstream job), 2) add circuit-breaker in SDK, 3) add dashboard alert for accept-queue and client_count anomaly. Assigning this to sam/jade.

sam: copying relevant logs to the ticket and will open a post-incident task to profile long lived clients. If we see repeats, plan: tune connection pooling in services and enable client-side backoff.

matt: temporary DB relief we applied: bumped pgbouncer pool size slightly and enabled query timeout 5s to avoid long transactions holding connections.

incident-bot: PD12345 status: acknowledged, mitigation in progress.

jade: handing monitoring back to sam for the next 30m. If everything stays stable for 30m, we'll resolve and create follow-up items.

sam: ack — taking watch. I'll escalate to maria if error rate creeps back >3% for 5m.

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 resolved by sam at +42m — root cause: connection storm plus retry behavior saturating redis clients; mitigations: added capacity, temporary maxclients bump, edge throttling, pgbouncer timeouts. Follow-ups created: PROJ-1234 (investigate retry storm), PROJ-1235 (add SDK circuit-breaker), PROJ-1236 (dashboard accept-queue alert).

support-lead: closing customer update with resolution note and ETA for follow-ups. Thanks team. :tada:
